name: University of British Columbia
summary: About 72,100 students on two campuses, Vancouver and Okanagan; Arts, Science, Applied Science, Commerce and more on the Pacific coast.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, at least 24 points including bonus points, though most programs ask more; English A at least grade 3. Maths AI SL is not accepted. Science and engineering list further subjects.

dates.label: Apply and submit award application: International Scholars Program
Application deadline, Winter Session 2027/28, 11:59 p.m. PST
Documents due from high school applicants outside Canada
Final transcript due to confirm the offer (out-of-country applicants)

programmes.name: Computer Science (BSc, Vancouver)
programmes.about: A four-year Science degree covering databases, operating systems, software engineering, security and web development, with honours and optional paid co-op. Majors can now take an Artificial Intelligence option.
programmes.ib: Maths AI SL is not accepted; Chemistry and Physics prerequisites can be waived with a 5 in IB Chemistry and a 5 in your Maths course.

needs.note: One of the three; Chemistry and Physics also needed, waived with 5s

programmes.selectionNote: Competitive on interim IB grades in relevant subjects, plus the personal profile. 24 points with bonus is only the floor; offers are confirmed on final results.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science at UBC Vancouver: BSc with honours, co-op and a new Artificial Intelligence option

programmes.name: Commerce (Sauder School of Business)
programmes.about: A four-year business degree on the Vancouver campus with ten specializations, from accounting and finance to marketing and real estate, and an optional co-op that alternates study with paid work terms.
programmes.ib: Complete IB Diploma with at least three HL courses; Maths AA SL or HL, or AI HL (AI SL not accepted). A personal profile is part of the application.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB grades and the personal profile written for your application. 24 points with bonus is only the floor; competition for Commerce is stiff.

flagshipSource.title: Commerce at UBC: ten specializations, study abroad at 61 partner business schools and an optional co-op

faculties.name: Faculty of Applied Science (Engineering)
faculties.line: Maths, Physics and Chemistry required; technical experience and the personal profile count; first-year places are limited.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: No set prerequisites; academic performance, personal initiative and the breadth and rigor of your studies decide.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Maths AA SL or HL, or AI HL, and one lab science; marks in relevant courses, rigor and out-of-school achievements count.

faculties.name: Sauder School of Business (Commerce)
faculties.line: Full Diploma with three HL; Maths AA or AI HL; the personal profile is read alongside your grades.

notes: Tuition is the 2026/27 rate for a full course load; students starting in 2026/27 have increases capped at 3% a year for four years or until graduation.
Most UBC applicants write a personal profile (500 to 2,100 characters per answer); Music and the Design in Architecture degrees are exceptions.
Application fee is CAD 173.25 for international students needing a study permit.
